feature: Quick save and configurable Chrome keyboard shortcuts
verification: 26 automated tests passed, including production background command routing
Quick save considers all three mocked tabs despite partial selection
Cancel leaves storage, open tabs and panel choices unchanged
Confirm saves a new collection before closing the captured tabs
Quick-save URL request opens confirmation and consumes its fragment
Shortcut dialog displays actual mocked assignments and opens Chrome configuration
Closing shortcut dialog restores focus to its trigger
limitations: Native operating-system shortcut dispatch was not exercised; command routing and UI were tested using Chrome API mocks.
